title: The PR ledger stacks pull requests by base ref.
ruling: Stack by base ref stands (coordinator pick, 12:01 CST Nov 12, PR 2845): the ledger stacks a PR by its base ref, not by a Based on line in the body. The three 72 hour limits (fix check, fresh full review, lane round 2 or later) are retired at 12:14 CST Nov 15 (coordinator pick, relayed; not owner-typed; undoable) under the owner's R37: fixed numbers he did not rule are retired or derived from measured runs. The PR 2845 lane applies this when it rebases. Unchanged: a done record with no lane-lint PASS reads lane lint, owner the lane; lane lint 72 hours and counted in the longest wait (the lane's own pick, 12:13 CST Nov 12) is not named in the retirement and is left for the lane to flag; a held, parked or replaced label with no valid Waits on line reads none and red, even on a draft.
quote: Coordinator picks used (12:01 CST Nov 12): stack by base ref ... 72 h for fix check, fresh full review and lane round 2+
source: PR 2845 body, Summary; written by the lane (author shivinate7), reporting the coordinator (12:01) and the lane (12:13) Filed by triage 11:47 CST Nov 13 from backlog-drain's close-evidence (#3154); the words are the PR text, relayed by a lane, not a direct owner quote unless the source says so.
